opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households who are not eligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government, ordinarily resident in Scotland, have completed at least two full years of secondary schooling or college in Scotland (or have a substantial recent connection), are entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK (or have limited leave to remain or are asylum seekers), and are enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at a Scottish Institute of Higher Education.
opportunities.summary: Provides tuition fee grants up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students in Scotland who are from low‑income households and not eligible for government tuition fee support.
